text:
Type: rattan rocking chair
Use: rocking, relaxing, reading; living room, bedroom, nursery
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, bohemian
Materials: hand-woven rattan back and seat, pale solid wood frame and runners, dark grey steel rods
Colors: light natural rattan, pale wood, dark grey
Shape: large rounded oval woven back, open lattice weave, thin wooden armrests on steel rods, slim spindle frame, curved wooden rockers, light and airy
Feel: airy, crafted, calm, natural
Goes with: light wood, white walls, linen, plants; Scandinavian, Japandi or bohemian living rooms

product.name: GRNADAL
product.description: Handwoven backrest and seat, making each and every GRNADAL one of a kind.
